name: stage-key-legibility
note: P1-6 (SDD persona goalpost): the Stage's glance key line (#pKeyLine, .pKey - the fastest thing a performer's eye checks mid-song) rendered SMALLER (.7rem/11.2px) than the artist line (.pArtist, .8rem/12.8px) beneath the title, inverting the visual hierarchy of what matters live. Fix: pKey >= pArtist's own size, with a 13px absolute floor. Red-first: pre-fix pKey computed font-size < pArtist's. VOLLEY-1: the fixture now uses an explicit-key song that opens OFF its tonic (key Am, first chord F), because the previous tonic-first fixture made 'Key ' + firstChord and 'Key ' + key indistinguishable - the label bug was invisible to it. Operator ruling 2026-07-25: the mode is SPELLED in minimum characters ('Key A Min') - a bare 'Key A' reads identically for A major and A minor.

steps.label: seed an explicit-key song that does NOT start on its tonic (key Am, opens on F) - a tonic-first fixture cannot tell 'key' from 'first chord'
steps.js: (function(){try{localStorage.setItem('roadcase-ukulele-gcea.custom.v1', JSON.stringify([{id:'keyLegibilitySong', t:'Key Legibility Song', a:'Me', y:2026, d:'Mine', custom:true, key:'A', mode:'minor', seq:['F','C','G','Am'], sheet:[['Verse','[F] a [C] b [G] c [Am] d']]}]));return true}catch(e){return false}})()

steps.label: the Stage is open with a live key line
P0 (operator UAT): the key shows by DEFAULT at transpose 0, not only when transposed - pKeyLine must start with 'Key '
pKey's computed font-size is >= pArtist's AND >= a 13px absolute floor (FAILS pre-fix: pKey .7rem/11.2px < pArtist .8rem/12.8px < 13px)

RED GOALPOST (volley-1 high + operator ruling 2026-07-25): the Key line names the KEY and SPELLS THE MODE in minimum characters - song is in A minor and opens on F, so 'Key F' is the old bug and a bare 'Key A' is the ambiguity the ruling fixed (A major and A minor would read identically)
